study_identification_part.si4_title: Probing individual-level structural atrophy in frontal glioma patients

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Introduce an individual-level structural abnormality (W-score) method to detect non-tumoral atrophy in frontal glioma patients and examine associations between abnormality indexes and tumor characteristics (size, grade, molecular markers).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Spearman correlations with tumor volume, CCI, MOCA; two-sample t-tests for categorical biomarkers (IDH, 1p/19q, TERT, MGMT, histological grade); FDR correction.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Patients show unique non-tumoral atrophy patterns with shared MTL involvement; abnormality indexes relate to tumor size and differ by IDH, 1p/19q, and TERT status.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: GM/WM relative atrophy ratios negatively correlated with tumor volume (power-law; r ≈ -0.671 and -0.684; both p<0.0001) and remained after excluding grade III/IV. WM contralateral atrophy ratio differed by IDH mutation status; WM relative atrophy ratio differed by 1p/19q co-deletion; GM and WM relative atrophy ratios differed by TERT mutation status; no significant relationships with MOCA, MGMT, or CCI.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: SAM-based indexes may aid presurgical inference of glioma molecular markers and highlight risk for cognitive impairment; single-site implementation on routine T1 images suggests feasibility.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Uncertain optimal W-score threshold (used |W|>6); sex and TIV not well matched between patients and controls; inclusion of perifocal edema in tumor masks may affect WM indexes, especially in high-grade lesions.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: All participants were right-handed. Single Philips Ingenia 3T scanner. Tumor segmentation performed on T2-FLAIR in ITK-SNAP with manual correction; tumor masks included perifocal edema. Preprocessing via CAT12 with MNI normalization (optimized shooting) and 4-mm FWHM smoothing; SPM templates used for masking. SAM masked to non-tumoral regions using SPM priors (threshold 0.2).
